All 182 unique galaxies in s4g_image_geometry_manifest.csv, the default manifest used by the interactive tool.
Latest dated categorical decision for each galaxy across catalogue and blind reviews. Severity scores are independent and are not converted into categorical labels.
No categorical decision found. Missing decisions are not treated as Clean.
Adopted centre_x_pix / centre_y_pix from the manifest, in 1-based FITS pixels, transformed using each original FITS header: CD matrix, forward SIP terms where present, and inverse TAN projection.
ICRS; FITS headers record EQUINOX 2000. RA and Dec are decimal degrees, with sexagesimal copies for readability.
North when declination > 0; South when declination < 0; Equator when declination = 0. This is celestial hemisphere.
Great-circle angular separation from NGC 1399, not a projected physical distance or a cluster-membership determination.
03:38:29.083, -35:27:02.67 (ICRS), from SIMBAD. Reference degrees above are editable and separation formulas update.
The tool reads only candidate_union_rereview_decisions.csv. This column preserves that display label; Status also includes later/other recorded categorical reviews.
Recorded source timestamp, retained as text to preserve the original local time; source files do not specify a timezone.
